chunks: So We ransomed him for a great sacrifice,
ai.seo_question: What was the great sacrifice that ransomed Ibrahim's son?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is central to the theology of the Ayyam al-Tasbih, marking the culmination of Ibrahim’s ultimate test of submission. The 'great sacrifice' (dhibh 'azim) is interpreted not only as the ram but also as a prophetic foreshadowing of the ultimate ransom of Imam al-Husayn (AS), linking the patriarchal narrative to the Ahl al-Bayt's redemptive role in Islamic history.
